paragraphs.text: "Rejoice, blessed evangels! The glorious light of *compleation* is nigh. Soon, we shall awaken the Multiverse from its slumber."
"His blades were the ultimate agents of transformation. All Phyrexians who met them were transformed into pieces." —*Heroes of the Second Invasion*
"Wherever it went, death came to Phyrexians and Kamigawans alike." —Records of the Living Historians
While the other praetors eagerly prepared for invasion, Urabrask retreated to the Furnace Layer, defying Elesh Norn's commands.
Though Phyrexian machines could adapt to extremes of heat or cold, they never figured out how to adapt to both at once.
Leading from behind had never been her style.
Her concoctions corroded metal and fortified organic tissue. They would be studied for generations.
She protected Ravnica with the same things that thrilled her fans: courage, charisma, and a grand assortment of spiked chains.
"The *Weatherlight* gave so much. It deserved justice as much as any of us." —Shanna
Her uncanny predictions of Phyrexian movements saved countless lives, though she never revealed the source of her information.
Martyred for worshipping her ancestors, she now walks among them.
"The Gitaxians whisper among themselves of other worlds. If they exist, we must bring Phyrexia's magnificence to them."
Descendant of a vanished land, student of a forgotten general, and master of blades no smith could forge anew. He honors them all by living a life worthy of song.
"As this conflict grows, it gets harder to prevent the city from breaking down. How much longer can we keep this machinery balanced?"
"Thraben is our home and I will not see it fall to this unhallowed horde."
"The echo of silence is music to my ears."
Every path ever charted by an Omenseeker is etched into her eyes.
"It is not a goal, but a process—the process of creating the perfect Phyrexia."
"My ancestor Toshiro used to say, 'Life is a series of choices between bad and worse.' I'm a master of making great bad choices."
Mourning shifts seamlessly to celebration as she chooses her next suitor.
"From the ashes of Reito rose a new kami. And thereafter at every battle came Horobi, Death's Wail." —*The History of Kamigawa*
"If you would taste the wisdom of the oni, be prepared to salt it with your blood." —Kiku, Night's Flower
When Belzenlok's lieutenant Yar-Kul grew too ambitious, the Demonlord transformed him into a maggot. The frog that ate the maggot grew and grew, until a ravenous spirit burst from its body.
"You gotta be pretty smart to live long as me, but not being able to die helps."
When the Mirran resistance arrived, the furnace dwellers looked to Urabrask for guidance. His decree stunned the others: "Let them be."
The hammer strikes. The Flame awakens.
"A hedron holds magic for a thousand years—or less, if need be."
"Come, Koma, and reclaim what you lost! Or does the great serpent fear a rematch?"
You don't want to know how she got that name.
"Even in death, we never stop growing."
Where Razia was aloof and untouchable, Aurelia is on the frontlines, calling for war.
The peaks of Hurloon never fall silent.
She is both shepherd and reaper, and her judgment is final.
At the end of the show, she stands alone on a stage brilliant with blood.
"What a show! We're going to make a killing tonight."
Weeping, the hunter cast aside her bow, struck by the majesty of the creature before her.
"Enough warm-up. I'm coming for you, Sheoldred!"
"This old ship has seen a lot, but she's not done yet."
"There's always room for improvement."
"Consider yourself lucky. Not everyone is granted the gift of *compleation*."
"I am heir to many treasures. None is as precious as knowing how my ancestor lived her life."
While Kaya is guildmaster, Teysa waits patiently at the center of the Orzhov web of power.
"Yarok grieves within the waste Of Bala Ged's corrupted land." —*Lament for Bala Ged*, stanza 1
The Machine Legion coveted her strength, but a spirit of sand, sun, and memory could never be *compleated*.
"Always have the right tool for the job, especially if the job is blasting Phyrexians in the face." —Monument inscription
No stranger to monstrous foes, Thalia marshaled surviving cathars, townspeople, and even ghoulcallers into an unbreakable fighting force.
In light of his zealous defense of Kaladesh, the Consulate was willing to overlook any previous transgressions.
Her fleet bore countless survivors to safety, slipping swiftly through strange currents no Phyrexian could track.
His knowledge of the Multiverse enabled New Phyrexia to strike each plane with surgical precision.
"Her talent for slipping unseen behind enemy lines provided information that would prove crucial to Dominaria's defense." —*Heroes of the Second Invasion*
"Wherever it went, death came to Phyrexians and Kamigawans alike." —*Records of the Living Historians*
"In its hatred for the mortal realms, it fought on the side of the invaders, heedless of its own eventual fate." —Records of the Living Historians
Consuming even a single drop of the oil would spell doom for most living things. But Yargle was not most living things, and he ate enough to clean up most of Urborg.
Squee had never wanted to be a king or a symbol of defiance against Phyrexians. Naturally, he found himself as both. —*Heroes of the Second Invasion*
To her delight, she was able to fully realize the explosive magical potential of hedrons.
"I always said I had a score to settle with that serpent. I'm a man of my word."
She whispered ancient rites over the fallen, bidding their essences return to the land before they could be repurposed by the machines.
"Teach these people the price of their insolence." —Elesh Norn
Invader after invader fell before her, and to each she spoke a single word: "Unworthy."
"Sure, the invasion was violent, but where was the beauty? As an artist, I had to intervene."
"Those mindless drones could never have defeated us. We are Keldons." —Grand Warlord Radha
His impromptu demonstration of the portable energy shield attachment both saved lives and increased demand for aether-powered multi-tool gauntlets tenfold.
While many fought valiantly to preserve humanity, Rona wished only to strip hers away.
"Its blighted heart, its spinous hands To break the hosts that foul its lands." —*Triumph of Bala Ged*, stanza 6
